title: Product itself is fine, seller may have ruined it
text: Product itself is fine, seller may have ruined it. Mine came with some stickers on them that would NOT COME OFF!  By the time I finally got them off, the product looked well-used, now it's scratched and cloudy from efforts to get the stickers off.  Just don't order from "LC Avocado."
